quotations.old_english: Gif huoelc uiðirmoedo (contraria) sindon in húse esnes ðínes
Ic (Eve) wæs wiþerméde and unwísum nétenum gelíc geworden

source_text: wiþer-méde; adj. I. contrary-minded, contrary, adverse, hostile, opposed :-- Se wiðerméda (the devil), Andr. Kmbl. 2391; An. 1197. Gif huoelc uiðirmoedo (contraria) sindon in húse esnes ðínes, Rtl. 123, 12. II. opposed to good, perverse, depraved :-- Ic (Eve) wæs wiþerméde and unwísum nétenum gelíc geworden, Blickl. Homl. 89, 9. [O. H. Ger. widar-muoti injuriosus.] v. wiþer-médu, wiþer-mód, and next word.
